approved_scope: boat-mounted or shore RGB; user approved water-obstacle definition 2026-10-22

definitions.powered_vessel: Motorized watercraft, including motorboats, powered ships and jet skis. Generic boat/vessel labels alone do not establish this class.
definitions.sailboat: Watercraft with identifiable sailing rig; remains sailboat when sails are furled.
definitions.small_craft: Nonmotorized kayak, canoe, rowboat, paddleboard or surfboard on water. Motorboats and jet skis belong to powered_vessel.
definitions.navigation_marker: Waterway navigation buoy or marker. A floating lifebuoy/rescue aid is other_obstacle.
definitions.person_in_water: A person physically in the water, swimming, floating or partially submerged. Exclude people aboard craft, standing on boards, on shore or on structures.
definitions.other_obstacle: Floating debris, logs, unattached rescue equipment and animals in the water. Exclude flying birds and permanent shore/port structures.

out_of_scope: people aboard craft or on shore
piers, docks, bridges and shore structures
unresolved_policy: Whole-image quarantine or full-frame audited relabeling. Never guess generic boat/person/other labels and never drop unresolved target objects into background.
box_policy: Tight axis-aligned box around visible object extent; include the vessel and its aboard occupants as one craft box where source convention supports it. Do not box reflections or wakes. Record source convention; quarantine incompatible boxes for correction.
coordinate_policy: Canonical zero-origin continuous xyxy with exclusive upper extent; no silent clipping, shrinking, small-object dropping or box union. Source conversions must have an explicit tested convention.
class_id_stability: The names list is the immutable deployment order.
